game_title: Mutation Mystery – Fallen Statue Garden Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden, a garden of fallen statues: the spirit seeker must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Mutation Mystery: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden: a garden of fallen statues
core_gameplay_loop: In Fallen Statue Garden, repeat each round: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the spirit seeker ahead. Then check the mutation_safe value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ancient lock by solving code steps involving mutation_safe that move the spirit seeker forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ancient lock first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 4 (applied tier): Mutation Mystery
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mutation Mystery' (Week 7 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Fallen Statue Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how mutation_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against stone sentinels in Fallen Statue Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
